title: fix(service-datasource)!: POST /datasources/:name/test answers an unknown name 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND
body:
domain:server#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXcN9HaZYSEUdJWEjw

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVpEmthvkRbuHGjC6oSQZvd)_

Fixes #27510

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/test` and the in-process `ExternalDatasourceService.testConnection(name)` refuse a name that resolves no saved datasource with `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, which they answered `200 { ok: false }` before. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no content/docs page or skills/** file states what `POST /api/v1/datasources/:name/test` answers (grep for the route, `test_connection` and `testConnection` over content/docs and skills/ found none; data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx names only `GET /api/v1/datasources`); the `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` example in protocol/kernel/error-handling.mdx is `GET /api/v1/datasources/:name`, whose answer this door now matches.


## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`POST /api/v1/datasources/NAME/test` 遇到不存在的数据源名，现在返回 `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`(与 `GET /datasources/NAME` 同码同文案),不再返回 `200 {ok:false}`。
- **为什么改**:原来"数据源不存在"和"数据源连不上"返回一模一样，管理工具和脚本无法区分;其它按名字访问的接口早已统一为 404。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低，只影响查无此名的请求;已存在但连不上的数据源仍是 `200 {ok:false}`,主数据源 `default` 即使没有存储记录也照常测试。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `external-datasource-service.ts` 的 `testConnection` 开头新增的存在性检查;② 新测试 `saved-datasource-test-unknown-name.test.ts`;③ 两个旧测试里补上的数据源记录。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource exec vitest run src/__tests__/saved-datasource-test-unknown-name.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ExternalDatasourceService.testConnection(name)` first resolves the saved record through `getDatasource`. This is the same stored-record read that the sibling by-name doors make: both plugins wire it to `metadata.get('datasource', name)`. When nothing is stored under that name, it throws a `404` / `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` error in the words `GET /datasources/NAME` uses. The admin route's existing relay in `badRequest` answers that error as `404`, so the route handler is unchanged.
- The primary datasource (`default`) is not looked up. It may have no stored record, and its live driver answers for it, as before.
- Every other outcome is unchanged. A saved datasource that fails its probe still gets `200 { ok: false, error }`, and one that is up still gets `200 { ok: true, … }`.
- Two docblocks in `admin-routes.ts` now list the Test door among the by-name doors that answer `404`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/service-datasource` patch.

## Tests

- **New: `src/__tests__/saved-datasource-test-unknown-name.test.ts`.** It runs through the real HTTP door over the real composition: `ObjectQL`, the connection service and driver factory, the admin service, the `ExternalDatasourceServicePlugin` wiring, and the admin routes on Hono. It has 5 cases:
  - An unknown name answers `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, names the datasource and has no `data`.
  - That answer has the same status, code and message as `GET /datasources/NAME` for the same name.
  - Control: a saved datasource with no live driver keeps `200 { ok: false, error }`.
  - Control: a saved datasource that is up keeps `200 { ok: true }`.
  - Control: the primary datasource with **no stored record** is still tested through its live driver and answers `200 { ok: true, latencyMs }`.
- **Red first.** The new file ran at base `d4ff1a025f` before the fix and gave `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. The two failures were the unknown-name cases, which received `status: 200, success: true`.
- **Fixture triage (two existing files).** Five existing pins tested "a saved datasource with no live driver" under a name that had no stored record. Two of them did this over HTTP (`/ghost/test`), so they pinned this defect directly. Their assertions are unchanged. Each fixture now stores that datasource's record:
  - `primary-datasource-test-and-sync.test.ts`: `ghost` was added to `RECORDS`, and the health-check unit's `getDatasource` returns a record.
  - `saved-datasource-test-after-failed-connect.test.ts`: `ghost` is seeded into the records map, and the verdict units' `getDatasource` returns a record.
- **Package suite on the final head `1ae90cf405`.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test` gave `Test Files 59 passed (59)` and `Tests 989 passed (989)`. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, which covers the three test files: `--listFiles` counts 3/3) exited 0. `eslint --no-inline-config packages/services/service-datasource` exited 0.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, wrap mode)</summary>

The subject is imported from `src` by a relative import, so no `dist` is involved.

- A1 replaced the existence guard with `if (false ...)`. The new file went red with `2 failed | 3 passed (5)`: both unknown-name cases failed. The file was restored with blob `4750f4f6e7fb` equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
- A2 dropped the primary-datasource exemption. The new file went red with `1 failed | 4 passed (5)`: "the primary datasource with no stored record is still tested through its live driver" failed. The file was restored with blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, unchanged.** `GET /datasources/NAME/remote-tables` and `POST /datasources/NAME/object-draft` answer an unknown name `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR`. The code path is `assertFederationSource`: `getDatasource` returns `undefined`, `isFederationSource(undefined)` is false, and the door throws `notAFederationSourceError`. This is a separate discrepancy, named in the claim. This PR did not measure it over HTTP.
- A host that wires no `metadata` service now answers every non-primary name `404` at Test. `GET /datasources/NAME` already does the same in that host, because both read the same store.
- `datasource-route-ledger.ts` is unchanged. Its `POST /:name/test` note does not state what the route answers.

Each command ran with its exit code captured before any pipe, and the record was reconciled with `--ran`: **62 derived, 61 run green (exit 0), 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET — this gate reads built output, and some package has no dist/`. It needs a full-repo build, so the reading is left to CI.
- Dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm, claim amendment 6498154139), on `b09ea62c76`: `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the os-verify-lock, VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 350 passed | 3 skipped (353), Tests 2817 passed | 20 skipped (2837).
